sec1_about1: The teachers are collective partners of this project. They define the policies and promote the best pedagogy for making the project as effective as possible. They define the decision-making process and they elect a managing committee every year to act as the executive branch of the project. Due to their responsibility in society, they are expected to be guided by the highest level of ethical behaviors. ACS Mulingua promotes cooperation and not competition among teachers. In their role as the driving force and role models for all students, the teachers have to be references for the learners both for individual and collective progress. They are conscious that they shape and design the future of society, both at local and global level. Individually each teacher has the freedom to manage their page within the framework established by the association.
sec2_about1: Guided by the principle of mutual respect, the teacher-students relationship should be conducive to an excellent learning environment. Teachers have to abide by the Teachers Charter. Students are expected to show the highest standard of discipline and respect towards their teachers. However, the old relationship of acceptance and obedience is recognized as old fashion. We encourage questioning and analysis from the students. Teachers are not the “know all professionals” and students are not the “empty heads” that need to be filled. Teachers are also learners.
sec2_about2: “Whoever teaches learns in the act of teaching and whoever learns teaches in the act of learning” Paolo Freire
sec2_about3: “The teacher is of course an artist, but being an artist does not mean that he or she can make the profile, can shape the students. What the educator does in teaching is to make it possible for the students to become themselves”. Paulo Freire
sec3_about1: The teachers abide by the teaching methodology of the association which is influenced by the principles enunciated in CLIL (Content Language Integrated Learning). In a nut shell CLIL can be defined as the integration of using language to learn and learning to use language through the development of content. The teachers do not only teach the language but also teach another subject such geography, physics, biology, literature etc. through the target language. So the teachers in this project are not only by or multilingual but are able to teach another subject.
sec3_about2: We favor the communicative approach with particular attention to contextualized learning, multimodal instruction, culturally responsive teaching. Communicative approach emphasizes the use of the target language as a means of communication, rather than just memorizing grammar rules and vocabulary.
sec3_about3: We adopt teaching methods that prioritize the needs, interests, and experiences of the learners. This can involve using interactive and collaborative activities, providing opportunities for self-reflection and self-evaluation, and adopting teaching materials to the learner´s level and context.
sec3_about4: We encourage critical thinking. Teachers have to continuously reflect on their own beliefs, biases, and practices and engage in ongoing professional development to improve their ability to create inclusive and equitable learning environments.
sec4_about1: Teachers are encouraged to stay in line with all the developments happening in education, especially the development of CLIL and pedagogy at large. The association does its best to develop contacts around the world to support the teachers’ initiatives.
sec4_about2: Each year the teachers have to attend the yearly seminar on the development of pedagogy in the world.
sec4_about3: The yearly seminar will be animated by professional trainers in pedagogy. ACS Mulingua will also keep teachers up to date on major developments through this website.
sec5_about1: ACS Mulingua only acts as a facilitator for the teachers and as such are not employers of the teachers. The teachers are their own boss. The association collects the students’ tuition fee and give it to the teachers for the first month during the month that they are teaching. The students will then pay directly to the teachers one month class in advance. The fees that are claimed is decided by the elected administration of ACS Mulingua in consultation with the teachers. ACS Mulingua keeps 5% of what a student pays for the first month, when it is private classes (one -to- one) and 10% when it is group classes. Each teacher will have a personal account to which he or she can get access to at any time. The money received from the teachers will be used for the administration of the academia and the development of the project in all transparency. The administration should present a report on the revenue and expenses to the quarterly general assembly of the teachers.
